name: exp2_transition_matched_kuka
description: Registered construction of Experiment 2 (transition-matched Kuka control) for Seen and Unseen. Every value here is frozen before training.

O.description: Original episode-count arms (prefixes of the seeded pools).

A.description: Exactly `transitions` distinct transitions at each episode failure fraction phi; episode counts free, total episodes a multiple of `episode_multiple` so phi*N is an integer.

B.description: Equal normalized outcome-conditional length distributions at a fixed transition budget. Each length contributes 20*k_l episodes: 18S+2F at phi=.10 and 7S+13F at phi=.65. The common histogram is the integer solution closest to the pooled availability shape (least squares) under the per-length caps.

fallback.rule: If 31,600 is infeasible, budget_B = largest multiple of 1000 <= 0.9 * (maximum feasible B budget). Design A comparators at budget_B are added for both B fractions.

V.description: Shared seeded base of `base_successes` successes; add distinct transitions of further successes (V+S) or of failures (V+F) until the arm holds exactly `total_transitions` (Design A's budget), so V arms are transition-matched to A.

evaluation.prevalence_source: all eligible test episodes (before support exclusion)
